blocks.p: A note on this edition. This is the second part of Bunyan’s story, scene for scene, in modern English. Six years after Christian’s journey, his wife Christiana, their four sons, and her neighbor Mercy follow the same road, with the great-hearted guide Bunyan gave them. As in Part One, nothing has been added and no episode has been removed. The sentences have been rebuilt for a reader today while keeping Bunyan’s cadence and his refrain of “Then I saw in my dream.” His poems and songs are kept as rhymed verse. His Bible references stay in the text in brackets where he placed them; three that were misprinted in the source have been corrected. Dialogue is set as in a modern novel. The long conversations keep every argument but lose some repetition. The handful of names renamed in Part One keep their new names here, and two more have been renamed; the full list is at the back.
